findings.evidence: The bounded cutover initially widened the derived root-of-trust closure: its rationale comment made scripts/hunter_controller_admission.py reachable, which transitively references scripts/hunter_governance_revision.py, leaving that path outside the declared connector floor so the Defect Prevention Guard failed the push.

resolution_evidence.evidence: The second commit adds exactly scripts/hunter_governance_revision.py to connector_write_ingress.root_of_trust_paths and nothing else; the Defect Prevention Guard PASSes and test_cutover_grants_no_admission_surface_in_the_orchestrator keeps the floor non-bypassable. verified on this exact head by the focused cutover suite (21 tests), the orchestrator regression suite, tests/test_code_write_policy.py (29) and the Defect Prevention Guard

findings.evidence: Codex P2 comment 4140230298: read_head_pre_ready_review() can report invalid for a committed-but-unreadable request; the migration path propagated that into prerequisite_state while ensure_current raised only for present, so an invalid request returned None and reconcile exited green with no reviewer dispatched.

resolution_evidence.evidence: TERMINAL_REQUEST_STATES now covers present and invalid; test_unusable_request_creates_no_authority[unreadable-request] fails if the fix is reverted, and test_absent_or_unavailable_migration_request_stays_retryable keeps the benign states retryable. verified on this exact head by the focused cutover suite (21 tests), the orchestrator regression suite, tests/test_code_write_policy.py (29) and the Defect Prevention Guard
